scene: Your cheerful strumming delights the crowd and unlocks three transit gates ahead.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view along the bustling market plaza. Far left, a sleek neon bullet train waits at a platform. Centre, the Pacific Islander man strums his ukulele beside the cheering tea automaton. Right, a solar-sail junk rocks at a pier. Up high, a glass cable pod hangs ready on an overhead wire.
shown: a sleek neon bullet train waiting at an open platform on the far left
a glowing solar-sail junk moored at a wooden pier on the right
a glass cloud cable pod suspended from a wire up high
